messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the continuous-batching sync. We're leaning to subqueue fences + opportunistic prefetch, but we must lock an eviction contract, pacing knobs, and telemetry before merging.
sam: Concern: fencing many tiny subqueues leads to metadata fragmentation and allocator GC spikes. We should consider pooled subqueue representations.
lee: Also: per-subqueue structs increase scheduler heap; we should benchmark cardinality >10k.
anika: Draft eviction contract: soft-evict = cancel prefetches and deprioritize; let inflight drain. hard-evict = cancel inflight only on SLO breach or emergency reclaim. Reclaim order: prefetches -> queued tokens -> inflight small -> inflight large.
sam: Note: cancelling inflight small batches causes client retries; doc must include client-side retry/ idempotency guidance and server dedupe recommendations.
lee: Accounting suggestion: two quotas: prefetch_quota (soft, charged to tenant) and inflight_quota (strict, protected per-shard). Default sample: inflight_quota=16 tokens, prefetch_quota=64 tokens.
anika: Telemetry wishlist: per-subqueue (queued_tokens, prefetch_tokens, inflight_tokens, last_eviction_reason), eviction events with tenant/model/context, eviction_rebuild_cost timer, post-eviction tail-latency histogram. Retention: traces 7d, rollups 90d, ops debug 30d.
maria: Handoff (local fences) sketch: origin marks "handing-off" -> stops new prefetches -> drains bounded window -> emits checkpoint blob (tenant, model, kv_keys, seq_hint, queued_tokens) -> target claims checkpoint and resumes. If drain stalls, forced checkpoint with truncated KV state. Checkpoint is best-effort; callers tolerate warmup.
sam: Broker vs local fences: leaning local fences + soft cross-shard reconciliation; keep central broker as ops fallback.
lee: Add per-tenant pacing (token-bucket) to slow noisy prefetchers. Combine with prefetch_quota to limit resource hogs.
infra-bot: CI: branch continuous-batching/subqueue-fence updated; tests green on main-ci.
maria: Action items: sam draft eviction + retry semantics PR; lee POC local-fence + pooled subqueue structs; anika add telemetry tickets and dashboards; maria update RFC with checkpoint examples.
sam: I'll include sample numbers and a few microbench results in my PR.
lee: I'll prototype pooled struct memory model in the POC.
anika: Filing telemetry tickets now. :rocket:
maria: Closing thread for now; will reopen if RFC changes are breaking.
